verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a public REST API. It authenticates with API keys passed as Bearer tokens and is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (84 paths) with a per-endpoint "Try it" playground. A per-release breaking-changes register tracks API surface changes on a path-versioned /v1 API. The probe 404s only hit root-level OpenAPI paths and do not contradict the spec published under /docs. Missing for 10: API keys are restricted to the Platform/Enterprise editions, no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and no published deprecation-window or support-horizon commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.
you can pass the API key as a Bearer token in the header
Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (84 paths, server https://cloud.activepieces.com/api) backing its Mintlify API reference
The API reference renders the Mintlify "Try it" playground per endpoint
Activepieces maintains a per-release breaking-changes register covering API surface changes
